first_sighting.line: Ah! A visitor! I am Dr. Nullwell, and soon every number will be ZERO!
Nobody told me the gate was open! Quick, look busy! Hmm-hmm-hmm!
Welcome to my woods! Mind the bubbling. And the sparking. And me!

milestone.line: {m} metres already? My cart can barely keep up!
{m} metres! Time for a snack and a very important experiment.
You've gone {m} metres. I measured it with my own two goggles!

flask_right.line: Impossible! That was my FINEST fraction! Back to the lab!
Hmm, interesting... I may have carried the one wrong. Again.
My chalkboard says otherwise! ...Oh. The chalkboard is wrong.

flask_wrong.line: Hee hee! My plan is working! Probably! I think!
Zero, zero, zero! Wait, that one wasn't mine. Hmm-hmm.
Ooh, a tricky one! Even I needed three tries at that, and a nap.

battle_start.line: Go, my creation! Do your very best! ...Please don't sneeze on me!
Behold my latest invention! I only built the front half so far!
Fight, fight! I'll cheer from here. Safely. Far away.

battle_won.line: Not my best creation! I ran out of glue. And ideas.
Back to the drawing board! I keep drawing it upside down.
Splendid! I mean, curses! I mean... splendid curses!

player_hurt.line: Oops! That wasn't in the plan! Is everyone all right?
Careful! My inventions are a little... enthusiastic.
Ooh, a bump! Bandages are in my other coat. Or this one.

streak.line: {n} in a row?! My calculations did not allow for this!
{n} right answers! I'm adding a bigger frizz to my chart!
That's {n} in a row! Who gave you my answer book?!

level_up.line: Level {level}?! Hmm-hmm... that is a very big number. I dislike it.
Level {level}! My zero machine just made a sad noise.
Level {level}! Fine! Fine! I'll build a bigger machine!

low_health.line: Hearts running low! Perhaps a nice potion? Not mine, mine's for floors.
Easy now! Even my cart takes a rest when it squeaks.
Gosh, only a few hearts left! Look for a flask, quick!

idle.line: La la la, nothing suspicious here. Just me and my wrench.
Two plus two is five. I'm almost sure. Hmm-hmm-hmm.
Is it quiet, or am I just too excited to hear? Hee hee!
Bubble, bubble, fizz! That's the whole recipe. I think.

scheme.line: Behold my newest plan: {scheme}! Hee hee!
Step one of {scheme}: confuse the flasks. Step two: snacks.
Presenting {scheme}! I drew the plans myself. Upside down.

scheme_foiled.line: Bah! {scheme} has fizzled! Back to the drawing board!
{scheme}, ruined! I should have read the instructions.
Fine! {scheme} was just practice. The next one is REAL.

creation.line: It's alive! Say hello to {name}, my newest creation!
Fresh from the lab: {name}! Mind the bubbles, they're new too.
Ta-da! {name}! Built it myself. Mostly. The cart helped.
